concealed_damage_flags.rule: Water stain at the top of a wall suggests water running down inside the wall from above.
concealed_damage_flags.recommendation: Open the wall at the stain and trace the source above; check the cavity for wet insulation.

concealed_damage_flags.rule: Visible mold implies a sustained moisture source and growth on the hidden side of the material.
concealed_damage_flags.recommendation: Find and stop the moisture source; inspect the back of the affected board before any cosmetic repair.

concealed_damage_flags.rule: Moisture damage within 50 cm of a window suggests failed flashing or seal, with wet framing around the opening.
concealed_damage_flags.recommendation: Inspect window flashing and sill; probe the framing below the sill for rot.
